title: P&G Announces First Quarter Results for Fiscal Year 26/27
summary: P&G reported results for the first quarter of fiscal 2027.
body_markdown:
- Organic sales grew +4.0%
- Growth was broad-based: all product categories and all regions grew organic sales with focus markets up 4% and Enterprise markets up 5%.
- Core earnings per share were up 1%.
- Free cash flow productivity was 93%.
- We returned $3.9 billion of cash to shareowners through $2.6 billion in dividend payments and $1.3 billion in share repurchases.


This was a strong start to the year. We achieved positive sales and share trends across markets, consistent with the semester-to-semester progress we expected, behind the interventions being executed across categories, countries and customers.


While we continue to execute our plans in the near-term to return to sustainable growth, we’re also making progress on a longer-term reinvention of P&G capabilities to become the CPG Company of the Future.


For a deeper dive into the results announced today, read our press release. Slides and the webcast replay of earnings results are available at the[P&G Investor Event page](https://www.pginvestor.com/events-and-presentations/default.aspx) .
